# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityOptionAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.universe_settings.minimum_time_in_universe = timedelta(0)

        # Set the data normalization mode as raw for option strike-price comparability
        self.settings.data_normalization_mode = DataNormalizationMode.RAW

        # SPY option chain data to construct an iron condor strategy
        self._option = self.add_option("SPY")
        # Using Staddle() method, it will only return the best-matched contract for the symbol
        # For example, if we filter for weekly ATM calls, it will return the weekly ATM call contract
        # If we don't set expiry, it will return all contracts that match the filter
        contract = self.option_chain(self._option).get_best_match(
            lambda chain: chain.straddle(0, 0, True) & chain.expiry("SPY", 0, True)
        )
        self.plot("Option Contract", "Symbol", contract.symbol)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            return
        # Create an iron condor strategy using the abstraction method
        # It will automatically calculate the required quantities to neutralize the delta
        # It will only return a tradable strategy if the required capital exceeds the portfolio cash
        strategy = self.option_strategies.iron_condor(self._option, 0.05, 0.05)
        # Alternatively, use the manual method
        # strategy = OptionStrategies.iron_condor(self._option, 0.05, 0.05)
        # self.register_option_strategy(strategy)

        # Set the expiry of the strategy to be the next Friday
        strategy.expiry = self.date_rules.next_friday(self._option.symbol)
        # Or use a manual date set
        # strategy.expiry = self.date_rules.week_start(self._option.symbol) + 4

        self.plot("Option Strategy", "Expiry", strategy.expiry)
        self.plot("Option Strategy", "Delta", strategy.delta_target)

        self.buy_strategy(strategy, 1)
